slug: 2023-04-01 Digitalization of CRVS Systems in Africa (AfDB & COMESA)

facts.fact: The AfDB and COMESA assessment, from countries' own questionnaire answers collected October 2022 to April 2023, lists Eswatini among ten countries where all civil registration offices countrywide have digitised databases and all entry of vital events is done electronically; it gives no count of offices.

The AfDB and COMESA assessment (answers collected October 2022 to April 2023) lists Eswatini among the countries where all registration records are transferred electronically from local offices to regional offices and on to a central office, with entry of vital events done electronically in every office.

The AfDB and COMESA assessment's statement that Eswatini's records move electronically from local offices to the centre is made of birth and death records, and it says all entry of vital events there is electronic (answers collected October 2022 to April 2023).

systems.platform: not named; data hosting outsourced, one of six countries the study lists as not hosting their own data
systems.tiers: all civil registration offices at district level countrywide

systems.system: Link between the CRVS system and the patient-level electronic health record system
systems.tiers: one of six countries the study lists with interoperability between the two systems

note: Read from the artefact PDF. A 43-country questionnaire survey reporting countries' own answers; no system is named for Eswatini. Its row in the software-capabilities table (Table 8) cannot be read reliably from the PDF's text layer and is not used.
